decisions.quote:
Children’s engagement did not consistently vary based on protagonist
race. However, of the four children with sufficient data to analyze book preference, all demonstrated
a marked preference for books with a same-race protagonist.
decisions.reason: The original study (Hardy et al., 2020) reported negligible effects of protagonist race on engagement and a selection bias toward same-skin-color protagonists (Introduction, p. 38). Because this replication likewise found no consistent engagement differences by protagonist race and a marked preference for same-race protagonists among all children with sufficient choice data, both results agree with the original findings and the outcome is successful.
